_comment: NCBI nuccore efetch replay fixture. Synthetic, deterministic GenBank record (taxon:32630 'synthetic construct' is the real NCBI taxon id for artificial sequences). Matches the request NcbiNuccoreProvider sends for accession NC_000000.1; used by e2e/electron/sequence-import-ncbi.e2e.ts. Not a real NCBI record.
